## Project

This research project conducts a supply-side analysis of news content on social media platforms, including TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube Shorts. Complementing the [Reuters Digital News Report](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/), which primarily focuses on survey data and news consumption patterns, our study examines the content and dissemination of news on these platforms. We investigate the characteristics of news content, analyzing its styles, formats, and publication patterns. By focusing on the strategies and content production from news organizations and creators, this project aims to provide an understanding of how news is presented within the evolving landscape of short-form video and visual-first platforms.
